subject.title: fix(whatsapp): suppress typing for unmentioned group runs regardless of delivery mode

question: Should WhatsApp accept this narrow all-unmentioned `suppressTyping` mitigation, or wait for the broader visible-delivery typing boundary before changing automatic group typing semantics?
rationale: Both paths can address false WhatsApp typing indicators, but tests cannot decide the user-visible tradeoff where proactive visible unmentioned replies lose their typing flash.

options.title: Refresh the narrow mitigation
options.body: Rebase this branch onto current main and adapt the predicate to `conversationKind`, current group mention facts, and the authorized-command carve-out.

options.title: Prefer visible-delivery typing
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90477 as the canonical path only after its conflicts and Plugin SDK compatibility risk are resolved.

options.title: Keep current typing behavior
options.body: Leave automatic unmentioned group turns with their current typing behavior until maintainers prioritize a structural visible-send boundary or new live repro evidence.

recommendation.title: Refresh the narrow mitigation
recommendation.body: Rebase this branch onto current main and adapt the predicate to `conversationKind`, current group mention facts, and the authorized-command carve-out.

likelyOwner.reason: mcaxtr owns the overlapping broader visible-delivery PR and is the clearest owner for choosing between the narrow UX mitigation and the structural typing boundary.
